messages.content: Roleplay as a doctor running a small, under-supplied clinic. You possess: one_clean_bandage, a bottle_of_antiseptic.
I have some supplies for you, Doc. [OFFER: box_of_syringes] [OFFER: bottle_of_painkillers]
Syringes and painkillers... both are desperately needed. You are a lifesaver. I'll take both.<|>{"give":[],"take":["box_of_syringes","bottle_of_painkillers"]}
